description: In ESA SNAP Desktop, open the Sentinel-2A GeoTIFF file located at /home/ga/snap_data/sentinel2a_sample.tif using File > Open Product. Once the product is loaded in the Product Explorer panel on the left, double-click on the product name to expand it and view its bands. Then right-click on one of the bands and select 'Open Image Window' to display the raster image on the main canvas. The file is a real Sentinel-2A image with 3 bands (Blue, Green, Red) at 10m resolution.
